issues.description: The Person entity's id field is declared as Integer in the solution (model/Person.java) while the rest of the codebase (controllers, services, repositories, and tests) uses Long for person IDs. This mismatch between the field type and the expected Long id (used in method parameters, repository signatures and tests) will cause compilation/type errors and prevents the intended code from working correctly.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the id field type consistent across the project. Change the Person entity's id declaration to Long (private Long id;) and ensure the getter/setter types match Long. Alternatively, if Integer is intended, update all method signatures, repository generics, controllers, and tests to use Integer consistently. The simplest fix is to revert the solution model's id field to Long to match the template, repository, controllers and tests.
